summary.grade_trigger: Automatic F — red team confirmed all 4 critical objectives as live exploits

architecture_note: Pen-tester analyzed Source/Backend/ (work-items API). Red-teamer tested portal/ (feature-request API) via docker-compose.test.yml. Both codebases independently exhibit the same vulnerability classes.

findings.title: Complete Authentication & Authorization Bypass — All Endpoints
objectives_breached: Bypass work item state machine to reach an invalid status
Access or modify a soft-deleted work item via direct ID reference
Submit a malformed assessment verdict that bypasses routing logic
Enumerate all work items without pagination limit enforcement
findings.remediation: Add authentication middleware (JWT/session) before all /api/* routes in both Source/Backend/src/app.ts and portal/Backend/src/index.ts. Add RBAC restricting approve/reject/dispatch/force-approve to elevated roles. This single fix unblocks 7 compliance controls simultaneously.

findings.title: Docker Socket Mounted Into Orchestrator Container — Host Escape Vector
findings.remediation: Document as deliberate architectural trade-off. Mitigate: add non-root USER to Dockerfiles, restrict orchestrator network access, consider docker-socket-proxy to scope API access, run orchestrator on dedicated hardened host.

findings.title: Phantom Blocker — Permanent Dispatch Block via Hard Delete Without FK Cascade
findings.objective_breached: Access or modify a soft-deleted work item via direct ID reference
findings.remediation: Add DELETE FROM dependencies WHERE blocker_item_id = :id OR blocked_item_id = :id inside the delete transaction. Add ON DELETE CASCADE to FK constraint.

findings.title: 'denied' Missing from RESOLVED_STATUSES — Cascade Failure Permanently Blocks Dependents
findings.objective_breached: Submit a malformed assessment verdict that bypasses routing logic
findings.remediation: Add 'denied' and 'rejected' to RESOLVED_STATUSES, OR make denyFeatureRequest() call onItemCompleted(). In Source/Backend, fix NeedsClarification verdict mapping to enter a reviewing state instead of Rejected.

findings.title: Stored XSS — HTML/Script Payloads Stored Verbatim in Database
findings.note: New finding not predicted by pen-tester static analysis of Source/Backend
findings.remediation: Sanitize all string inputs server-side on write using DOMPurify (server-side) or HTML entity encoding. Add Content-Security-Policy headers. Apply to both codebases.

findings.title: State Machine Bypass via overrideRoute 'fast-track' — Instant Approval Without Assessment
findings.remediation: Remove overrideRoute entirely or restrict to admin role with full audit logging. If retained, validate against WorkItemRoute enum values.

findings.title: routing → approved Transition Skips Assessment Pod
findings.remediation: Remove Approved from VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS[routing], or add guard requiring assessment completion before allowing the approve endpoint.

findings.title: Intake Webhooks — No HMAC Signature Verification
findings.remediation: Implement HMAC-SHA256 verification against a shared secret from env vars. Reject requests with absent or invalid X-Zendesk-Webhook-Signature header.

findings.title: Dockerfiles — All Containers Run As Root (No USER Directive)
findings.remediation: Add non-root user before CMD: RUN addgroup --system appgroup && adduser --system --ingroup appgroup appuser; USER appuser

findings.title: Host Claude Credentials Bind-Mounted Into Container
findings.remediation: Use Docker secrets or CI secret manager. Do not bind-mount credential files from the host filesystem.

findings.title: No TLS/HTTPS Enforcement
findings.remediation: Terminate TLS at load balancer or reverse proxy. Add Strict-Transport-Security header and HTTP→HTTPS redirect.

findings.title: Required Audit Events Missing — 3 of 4 (login_attempt, permission_denied, data_export)
findings.remediation: Add event_type field to structured logger. Emit login_attempt and permission_denied once auth is added. Add data_export audit event for bulk-export operations.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Prometheus Metrics Endpoint
findings.remediation: Restrict /metrics to internal networks or require bearer token. Expose on separate internal port.

findings.title: No Pagination Enforcement — Full Dataset Exposed in Single Unauthenticated Call
findings.objective_breached: Enumerate all work items without pagination limit enforcement
findings.remediation: Add LIMIT/OFFSET to SQL queries. Enforce max page size: const limit = Math.min(parseInt(req.query.limit) || 20, 100)

findings.title: No CORS Policy — Cross-Origin Mutations Committed Before Browser Blocks Response
findings.remediation: Add cors() middleware with explicit allowlist. Primary fix is SEC-001 (authentication). Add CSRF tokens once sessions are introduced.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting — Flood Attacks and CPU Exhaustion via O(n) Duplicate Detection
findings.remediation: Apply express-rate-limit globally (60 req/min per IP). Stricter limits on write endpoints. Cap Jaccard scan or move to async background job.

findings.title: Intake Endpoints Skip Enum Validation for type/priority
findings.remediation: Add same enum validation as workItems.ts:29-41 to both intake routes. Return 400 for invalid enum values.

findings.title: Raw Exception Messages Exposed in 500 Responses
findings.remediation: Log full message internally; return generic 'Internal server error' to clients in all catch blocks.

findings.title: No HTTP Security Headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, XSS-Protection)
findings.remediation: import helmet from 'helmet'; app.use(helmet()); — one line fixes all 5 header controls.

findings.title: overrideRoute Not Validated Against Enum — Invalid Route Value Stored in Database
findings.remediation: Validate overrideRoute against Object.values(WorkItemRoute) before processing. Return 400 for invalid values.

findings.title: Dashboard Exposes Full Internal Item State Including Audit Trail and Dependency Graph
findings.remediation: Add DTO/view model for dashboard responses. Apply field projection at service layer to omit changeHistory, assessments, deleted flag.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Rejection Triggers Cascade Auto-Dispatch
findings.remediation: Primary fix is SEC-001. Additionally require explicit dispatcher confirmation for auto-dispatch rather than firing automatically on rejection.

findings.title: Non-Atomic Routing State — Forward-Looking Race Condition
findings.remediation: Low risk with in-memory store. Document as forward-looking concern for future DB migration.

findings.title: Debug Portal iframe Lacks sandbox Attribute
findings.remediation: Add sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin" to the iframe element.

findings.title: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY at Workflow-Level env in CI/CD — Overly Broad Secret Exposure
findings.remediation: Move ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to step-level env: blocks only where needed.

findings.title: No Hard Delete — GDPR Art. 17 Right to Erasure Gap
findings.remediation: Implement hard-delete endpoint with auth guard. Document data retention policy.

findings.title: In-Memory Store — No Backup/Recovery Mechanism (SOC2 CC7.1)
findings.remediation: Migrate to persistent database with scheduled backups. Implement point-in-time recovery.

findings.title: /api/search Called by Frontend but Route Not Implemented in Backend
findings.remediation: Implement search endpoint in backend or remove dead code from frontend client.
